CORRECTION to the earlier concern on this list that blamed concurrency. The access violation in flexicon FLExInit.py:64 (via the live flex fixture at test_034_standalone_preview_live.py:114) reproduces on a SOLO run with nothing else in flight, so concurrency is not the established cause. What is established: tests/integration emits that native fault and then usually HANGS (~23s CPU over 40+ min = blocked, not slow); three runs had to be killed; and a run killed mid-flight leaves a summary-less output file that grep scores as 0 failures, which is a trap - never treat a missing summary line as a pass. Only tests/unit (16s, no live FLEx) is a usable regression gate. Aggravating but unproven factor: 6 flextoolsmcp servers held live COM handles throughout.

BLOCKING for T028/Phase 4. data-model.md section 3 makes key_fn_id a REQUIRED roster field (it names the pure key-extraction function that makes a row executable) and NaturalKeyRosterEntry enforces it non-empty. But NONE of the six entries in specs/038-transfer-fidelity-gaps/contracts/natural-key-roster-extension.json carries key_fn_id or scope_fn_id, and neither do 035s three existing entries. Measured live via the T009 accessor: 0 of 3 current roster entries project successfully; all 3 are skipped for lacking key_fn_id. If T028 appends the six proposed entries verbatim, all six project to zero too and Phase 4 natural-key matching silently does NOTHING -- the exact silent-failure class this feature exists to remove. T028 must add key_fn_id/scope_fn_id during the merge, and the values cannot be chosen until the Phase 4 key-extraction functions exist. Also note the proposal nests rows under proposed_entries, not entries.

Roster JSON shape differs from the briefing in two ways the T009 accessor now tolerates: (1) the class-name key is "class", not "object_class" (data-model.md documents this correctly; it was my briefing that was wrong); (2) uniqueness_caveat is a dict on the ReversalIndexEntry row while NaturalKeyRosterEntry types it Optional[str], so the projection renders non-str values as stable sorted JSON rather than rejecting an otherwise-valid row on a shape difference alone.

FR-001.title: Match by identity first; consult any other basis only when identity finds no match

FR-002.title: Support matching by an agreed natural key when identity finds no match

FR-003.title: Admission to natural-key matching is by explicit enumeration in a governed roster

FR-004.title: Each roster entry states the key, uniqueness, ambiguity behaviour, and evidence

FR-005.title: Roster admits the starter classes a transfer would duplicate or drop

FR-006.title: Every natural-key match is recorded in the report, distinguishable from identity

FR-007.title: An unmatchable grammatical category is created or reported, never silently dropped

FR-008.title: Re-running the same transfer reaches the same items and creates no duplicates

FR-009.title: Produce a per-class comparison giving source count, destination count, difference

FR-010.title: The comparison excludes the content a newly created FLEx project ships

FR-011.title: The comparison is available machine-readable for a gate, plus human-readable

FR-012.title: The comparison covers every object class the engine can create

FR-013.title: Any item the transfer cannot reproduce appears in the report with the reason

FR-015.title: Items included by dependency are shown in preview, marked as pulled in

FR-016.title: Each pulled-in item is individually deselectable

FR-017.title: Every item left incomplete by a deselected or unsatisfiable dependency is reported

FR-018.title: Each declared dependency relationship is verified before it may influence a plan

FR-019.title: Each transferred affix is linked to its source template column, or the failure reported

FR-020.title: A matched destination item gains the child items its copy lacks, not a whole-object skip

FR-021.title: Enrichment never removes, blanks, or overwrites existing destination content

FR-022.title: The run report distinguishes an enriched item from a created one

FR-023.title: Affix process rules are reproduced with their input and output content

FR-025.title: An unreproducible item is reported and skipped, never converted to a simpler kind

FR-014.title: Selecting an item includes the items it depends on by default

FR-024.title: Process-rule references resolve to the destination items matched under FR-001 and FR-002
